china.headline_zh: 中国 — slow-luxury 的价值洼地
china.headline_en: China — the value frontier of slow luxury
china.manifesto_zh:
中国是慢奢旅行最被低估的目的地。匠庐、松赞这一批本土精品酒店，从设计语汇到服务密度都对标 Aman、Como、Soneva，但价差是供给侧便宜 + 国际品牌溢价没起来。对欧美 inbound 客来说，这是核心钩子；对中国本地高净值客户来说，是被遮蔽的近场胜地。

我们目前覆盖 4 个核心区域：贵州（匠庐主场）、云南（匠庐 + 松赞 + 木夕大里）、香格里拉（松赞）、四川（待开发）。
china.manifesto_en:
China is the most underrated destination for slow-luxury travel. The new wave of domestic boutique brands — Jianglu, Songtsam — match Aman, Como and Soneva on design vocabulary and service density, but pricing remains a fraction. For inbound travellers, that's the core hook; for China's HNW travellers, it's the hidden home-court win.

We currently anchor on four core regions: Guizhou (Jianglu home turf), Yunnan (Jianglu + Songtsam + MUXI), Shangri-la (Songtsam), and Sichuan (in development).

guizhou.headline_zh: 贵州 — 山野慢栖与避暑史诗
guizhou.headline_en: Guizhou — mountain slow stays and the cool-summer epic
guizhou.manifesto_zh: 贵州是 WR Journeys 中国 inbound 的开篇章节。匠庐在这里有 5 个不同形态的精品酒店 — 布依石头城堡（村晓）、彝乡高原山居（沙嘎）、苗乡耕读山居（耕读第）、集装箱山野美宿（阅山）、雅路古秘境。线路设计沿海拔梯度（1000-1800m）展开，夏日避暑、冬日观瀑、四季皆有戏。
guizhou.manifesto_en: Guizhou is the opening chapter of our inbound China programme. Jianglu operates five distinct boutiques here — a 600-year-old Buyi stone village (Cunxiao), a Yi-highland plateau retreat (Shaga), a Miao reading-and-farming retreat (Gengdudi), a container-architecture wilderness lodge (Yueshan), and the secluded Yalugu. Routes unfold along an altitude gradient (1,000–1,800m): cool-summer escapes, winter waterfalls, year-round drama.

yunnan.headline_zh: 云南 — 从苍洱山居到版纳雨林
yunnan.headline_en: Yunnan — from highland stays to tropical forests
yunnan.manifesto_zh:
云南是中国最被旅人爱过的省份，但真正的好酒店多到难选。我们在大理（金梭岛匠庐·蜜湾、木夕大里伙山）、丽江、香格里拉沿线深挖，按你的亲子、伴侣或独行画像配伍线路。

匠庐·蜜湾把整个金梭岛包了，洱海日出日落都在你窗外；木夕大里把白族建筑语汇做到当代极简的程度。大理适合把节奏放慢，丽江适合连接山地与古城，继续向北则要为海拔和长距离转场留出余量。

春秋通常最稳妥，雨季的云层和冬季的干燥光线各有价值。WR 顾问不会只按“热门景点”排列，而会先听你更在意住宿、风景、饮食还是亲子便利，再决定住几晚、删掉哪些转场，并由同一位真人从首次沟通跟到旅行归来。

向南来到西双版纳，云南换成雨林、澜沧江与傣乡的节奏。以景洪连住为基地，把基诺山、植物园和河流体验分在不同日子，适合另起一段五天四晚的度假。
yunnan.manifesto_en:
Yunnan is China's most romanticised province, with more good hotels than easy to choose from. We anchor on Dali (Jianglu Miwan on Jinsuo Island, MUXI Dali Houshan), Lijiang, and the Shangri-la corridor — paired to your family, couple or solo profile.

Jianglu Miwan occupies all of Jinsuo Island, with Erhai sunrise and sunset framing the windows. MUXI takes Bai architectural vocabulary into contemporary minimalism. Dali rewards a slower stay; Lijiang works as a bridge between old-town texture and mountain country; continuing north requires deliberate altitude and transfer planning.

Spring and autumn are usually the most forgiving, while summer cloudscapes and dry winter light each suit different travellers. A WR advisor first listens for what matters most — lodging, landscape, food, photography or family ease — then decides where to stay longer and which transfers to remove. The same real person follows the journey from first conversation to return.

Farther south, Xishuangbanna offers a different Yunnan: rainforest, the Lancang River and Dai culture. A single base in Jinghong supports separate days for Jinuo Mountain, the botanical garden and river experiences, forming a standalone five-day, four-night stay.

shangri-la.headline_zh: 香格里拉 — 雪山下的高原游牧
shangri-la.headline_en: Shangri-La — plateau nomadic life under snow mountains
shangri-la.manifesto_zh:
香格里拉行政上属云南，但文化和地理上独立成区。我们和匠庐·赛朵游牧、匠庐·雾浓顶（梅里雪山脚下）合作，做「高原慢游」主题线路 — 看雪山、走牧场、住山居、吃藏家私房菜。

冬季 12–3 月空气通透，梅里日照金山是高潮场景；春末到秋初更适合草甸和轻徒步，但雨季需要为道路与能见度预留弹性。这里不适合把松赞林寺、纳帕海、奔子栏和梅里全部压进两三天，海拔适应和停留质量比打卡数量重要。

WR 顾问会先聆听体力、睡眠、摄影和同行者年龄，再判断是否跨到梅里、在哪一站连住，以及哪些活动应作为天气备选。AI 帮我们更快整理信息和联络资源，路线判断与从出发前到归来后的照顾始终由真人负责。
shangri-la.manifesto_en:
Shangri-La is administratively part of Yunnan but culturally and geographically a region of its own. We work with Jianglu Saiduo Nomadic and Jianglu Wunongding at the foot of Meili Snow Mountain on plateau-slow-travel journeys: snow peaks, alpine pasture, mountain lodges and Tibetan home cooking.

December to March brings the clearest air and the best chance of Meili's sunrise alpenglow. Late spring through early autumn suits meadow walks, while the wet season needs flexibility for roads and visibility. Songzanlin, Napa Lake, Benzilan and Meili should not be compressed into two or three days; altitude adaptation and the quality of each stay matter more than collecting stops.

A WR advisor first listens to fitness, sleep, photography priorities and the ages of everyone travelling, then decides whether to continue to Meili, where to stay twice and which activities should remain weather alternatives. AI helps us organise facts and reach partners faster; route judgement and end-to-end care remain human.

sichuan.headline_zh: 四川 — 川西高原的下一章（开发中）
sichuan.headline_en: Sichuan — the next chapter on the Tibetan plateau (in development)
sichuan.manifesto_zh:
四川是 WR Journeys 接下来重点接入的区域。川西从康定、丹巴到稻城亚丁，距离看似相连，实际受到海拔、道路与季节影响，不能按平原城市之间的方式计算转场。松赞在相关区域已有成熟住宿网络，我们也在持续核验更多在地伙伴。

5–6 月适合高山花期，9–10 月通常拥有更稳定的秋色；盛夏要考虑降雨，冬季则需判断道路、保暖与部分服务停运。第一次进入高原的旅人，更适合从较低海拔逐步上升，并把至少一晚留给适应，而不是连续追赶景点。

公开标准线路尚在整理，但真人顾问已经可以按体力、时间、摄影或亲子需求做一事一议设计。我们会明确哪些段落已经实地或由可信伙伴核验、哪些仍需二次确认；AI 只帮助加快资料整理与联络，最终取舍和旅程责任由真人承担。
sichuan.manifesto_en:
Sichuan is the next major region being built into WR Journeys. Western Sichuan appears connected on a map, but Kangding, Danba and Yading are shaped by altitude, road conditions and season; transfers cannot be planned like journeys between lowland cities. Songtsam already provides a mature lodge network in parts of the region, while we continue to verify additional local partners.

May and June suit alpine flowers, and September to October usually bring the most dependable autumn colour. Summer requires rain buffers; winter needs careful checks on roads, warmth and seasonal closures. First-time plateau travellers are better served by a gradual ascent and at least one adaptation night than by chasing consecutive landmarks.

Public standard routes are still being prepared, but a real advisor can already design a bespoke journey around fitness, available time, photography or family needs. We distinguish what has been directly checked, what comes from trusted partners and what still requires confirmation. AI speeds research and coordination; the final trade-offs and responsibility for the journey remain human.
